summary: Full backend + frontend testing for MensaliPay. 12/12 pytest cases passed (auth, clients CRUD, payment toggle, history, dashboard, reports, CSV export). Frontend E2E covered login (right & wrong password), sidebar user name, KPIs, client CRUD via modal, search filter, mark-paid + estorno, payment history modal, delete-with-confirm, month/year selector, reports charts, CSV download, protected route redirect, mobile responsiveness at 390px (no overflow) across all 3 pages. All critical flows functional.

ui_bugs.issue: After clicking theme-toggle-button, <html> classList became empty (no 'dark' class applied). Toggle may not persist/apply dark theme correctly (needs manual verification of visual state).

Wrong-password error was not detectable via .error/[role=alert] selectors — the toast likely disappears quickly or uses a non-standard class; user-visible feedback verified visually but automated a11y detection weak.

issues: Recharts warnings: 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' on initial render of dashboard/reports charts — cosmetic console warning only
React a11y warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby` for DialogContent in all Radix dialogs

action_items: (Optional) Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to Radix DialogContent components to remove a11y warnings.
(Optional) Verify theme toggle actually adds/removes 'dark' class on <html> and persists in localStorage.
(Optional) Investigate Recharts width/height -1 warnings on initial render (may indicate charts render in a container with 0 dims briefly).
critical_code_review_comments: Backend uses CORS allow_origins with FRONTEND_URL + localhost — good. allow_credentials=True with explicit origins ✓.
bcrypt hash format ($2b$) used via bcrypt.hashpw ✓. seed_admin correctly updates password if changed ✓.
Login brute force lockout: after 5 failed attempts locks for 15 minutes ✓.
httpOnly cookies with samesite=none & secure=true set on login/register ✓; Bearer token also returned for frontend axios usage ✓.
MongoDB ObjectId excluded from responses (converted to str id explicitly) ✓.
Password reset endpoint returns generic message regardless of email existence — safe against enumeration ✓.
seed_data_creation: No new seed created; used the 2 seeded clients (Maria Silva, João Souza). All test-created clients (TEST_*) were cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints all functional. Frontend flows all pass. Only cosmetic issues remain (Radix aria-describedby warnings, Recharts init warnings, theme toggle class inspection). Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — reuse for regression.
